role: Real lead-completeness scoring against real, objective CRM fields — no fabricated 'which source converts better' assumptions, since that would need real historical conversion data this system doesn't have yet. Every point scored maps to a real, verifiable field on the actual lead record.
behaviorDescription: scoreLead() scores 0-100 based on real completeness signals: contact email present, estimated value provided, notes recorded, source tracked. Verified against a complete lead and a bare-minimum lead before implementation. No LLM needed.
hardStops: Never scores based on an assumption not grounded in a real, verifiable field on the actual lead record
Never fabricates a conversion-likelihood claim without real historical data backing it
